product_family: AI video generation platform (Synthesia Studio) with AI avatars, voice cloning, screen recording, and translation; plans span Free/Starter/Creator (self-serve, API on Creator+) up to Enterprise (SSO, custom limits, dedicated CSM)

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: We are SOC2 Type II compliant and fully certified within ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27701:2019, and ISO/IEC 42001:2023.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: Synthesia undergoes a periodic ISO 42001, ISO 27001, and SOC2 Type II audit. The report is available here.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27701:2019
certifications.proof_quote: Synthesia has successfully achieved ISO/IEC 27701:2019 certification, the leading international standard for Privacy Information Management Systems (PIMS)... as validated by A-LIGN with zero nonconformities during the Stage 2 audit.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (AI Management System)
certifications.proof_quote: This achievement builds on our existing ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 42001 certifications... Synthesia becomes first AI video platform to earn ISO 42001 certification (A-LIGN case study cross-check).

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Compliance: ... GDPR. See our Data Processing Agreement... data currently stored within the European Union (EU), in data centers based in Ireland.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Synthesia is not a Business Associate or subcontractor (as those terms are defined in the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act...) and customers should not submit, collect or use any protected health information (PHI)... Synthesia cannot support and have no liability for PHI received from Customer.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a PCI DSS attestation on the trust center, security practices page, or compliance list; payments are handled by a third-party processor, not directly relevant to Synthesia's own scope.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization on the trust center or elsewhere on synthesia.io.

certifications.name: CSA STAR (registry listing)
certifications.proof_quote: Trust center lists a completed 'CAIQv4.0.2 STAR Security Questionnaire' available to customers as a resource, but no confirmed public CSA STAR Registry listing was found for Synthesia; a completed CAIQ questionnaire is not the same as a registry-listed STAR certification.

privacy.ai_training_note: Vendor's AI Governance Practices page states directly: 'Synthesia does not use Customer Data, including inputs or outputs, to pre-train its AI Components.' AI components are instead trained on paid/commissioned actor performances, public performances, and licensed content. Any fine-tuning using customer data requires the customer's written instruction under their governing agreement. Custom avatars/voices require the depicted person's explicit consent before creation.
privacy.data_region: EU (Ireland) primary storage; operational backups in Ireland; secondary backups in AWS Frankfurt (EU).

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES-256 for all stored Customer Data

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Annual third-party penetration testing; 2026 executive summary and full report published as trust center resources

security.name: SSO / SAML
security.value: Available on Enterprise plan only (not on Free/Starter/Creator)

security.name: Sub-processors
security.value: Published sub-processor list; contractual obligations imposed on sub-processors for technical and organizational measures

security.name: Data deletion
security.value: Customer data deleted upon account/relationship end; avatar/voice deletion requests can take up to 90 days before permanent deletion, with confirmation provided

security.name: Business continuity / DR
security.value: Continuity and Disaster Recovery plans established and tested; cybersecurity insurance maintained

products.name: Basic (Free)
products.notes: 10 min video/month, 9 stock avatars, no API

products.name: Creator
products.data_scope: Standard cloud multi-tenant; no SSO; API access enabled
products.notes: 1 editor + 5 guests, 180+ avatars, live collaboration, API access

products.name: Enterprise
products.data_scope: Custom configuration; SAML/SSO available; dedicated CSM; same underlying security/compliance program as other tiers
products.notes: Unlimited video minutes, custom guest/editor limits, 240+ avatars, SSO

compare.pricing_model: Freemium + tiered subscription (Basic/Starter/Creator) plus custom Enterprise pricing; API access from Creator tier up
compare.data_residency: EU (Ireland primary, AWS Frankfurt secondary backup)

flags: Not to be confused with the unrelated 'Synthesia LLC' piano/musical-notation software trademark holder in the US. Synthesia Limited (UK, AI video company, synthesia.io) is a different company with a different product; no shared certifications.

HIPAA is explicitly disclaimed by the vendor: customers are told not to submit PHI and Synthesia states it has no liability for PHI received. This is shown as HIPAA: not supported / no BAA, not as an absence gap.
The trust center offers a completed CAIQ v4.0.2 questionnaire to customers on request, but this is a self-assessment questionnaire, not a confirmed public CSA STAR Registry certification listing.
SSO/SAML is Enterprise-tier only; lower tiers share the same certifications but not the same access controls, relevant for buyers on Basic/Starter/Creator plans.
